dino: official frozen ViT-B6912 existing development cache; StandardScaler then full-SVD PCA64, fitted on fold train only
fixed_blend: 0.8 * saved best018 outer OOF + 0.2 * TabICL outer OOF; no learned weights
resplit_gate: original fixed20blend improves overall RMSE and >=3/5 folds; only qualifying arms evaluated on existing 20261031 and 20261101 folds
continuation_gate: same fixed20blend improves all three split RMSE; otherwise stop, no full500/test
benchmark: original compact26 lowest fold, repeat predict, save/load, independent fresh fit; CPU peak RSS is process lifetime maximum
holdout_test: not read; no selection on either
limitations: many adaptive studies on same 400 IDs; resplits not independent samples; TabICL in-context inference rather than gradient training
